What this gift means to you
The file is already on your phone - installing takes a couple of seconds, nothing to download again.

WHAT IT IS A live message is a tiny app right in the chat: confetti, a player, a poll, a product card, revenue charts, a boarding pass, a clock, games and more. Your contact sees it the same way you do.
HOW TO SEND • Type “/” in the empty message field - a list appears. You can add the name right away: /poll, /product, /revenue. • Or hold the Send button → “🧩 HTML bubble” → “✨ Live messages”. • Tap one - a preview opens: “Send”, “✏️ Edit” or “Back”.
HOW TO MAKE IT YOURS (✏️) • Headers, captions, questions, prices - just type your own text. • Numbers for charts (/revenue): values separated by spaces, labels by commas - bars and the total are calculated automatically. • Lists (tracks, steps, poll options, rings, time zones, questions): one per line, parts separated by “|”, e.g. “🎥 Video notes|41”. • Picture: an https://… image link (product photo, link preview). The image loads from the internet when shown - the image site will see the viewer\'s address. • Link: the “Buy” button or the link card opens it - after a confirmation. • The preview at the top updates while you type. Below - the size: a message must fit in 1300 bytes.
ALREADY SENT • Hold the message - like any other: reactions, reply, “Edit” (the editor opens again - it updates for your contact), “Delete for everyone”.
SO THE CHAT DOESN\'T LAG • In the chat, live messages are shown as light ▶ cards - tap to bring one to life. The newest one comes alive by itself. • At most two are live at once - the rest turn back into cards. Off-screen ones are paused. • In lite mode nothing comes alive by itself.
SAFETY There is no access to your files or data inside; only pictures are loaded from the internet. A message can reply in the chat or copy text only after your tap.
